# UNC HTML adapter excerpts

Source structure inspected November 7, 2026:

- Catalog: https://catalog.unc.edu/courses/comp/ (2026–2027).
- Sections: https://reports.unc.edu/class-search/, normal public POST with subject COMP and term 2027 Spring.

`catalog.html` retains four public course-block structures, codes, titles, credits and designations. Long descriptions/requisites are replaced with synthetic text. `sections.html` retains the first four result rows (COMP 110 / 116); the subject rowspan and displayed totals are reduced to describe this excerpt. Meeting values are source records, not fictional schedules. These are parser fixtures, not complete or publishable datasets. No public CSRF tokens/cookies or student data are included.
